message: The other day, as the skies darkened and the wind picked up, my grandkids were busy building a fort out of couch cushions, completely unconcerned about the impending storm. I couldn’t help but chuckle; while I was preparing for the worst, they were just preparing for the next big adventure. It reminded me that a little calm in the face of chaos can be just as important as having a flashlight ready. How do you keep things light during stormy weather?
